description: This script automates code generation tasks for ANGLE project, managing dependencies, hashing, and invoking other scripts.

methods.name: get_child_script_dirname
methods.description: Returns the directory name of a script relative to the ANGLE root.

methods.name: clean_path_slashes
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes for platform independence.

methods.name: rebase_script_path
methods.description: Converts a script path to be relative to the ANGLE root directory.

methods.name: get_executable_name
methods.description: Determines the executable ('vpython' or 'python') based on the first line of a script.

methods.name: grab_from_script
methods.description: Runs a script to retrieve input/output dependencies based on a parameter.

methods.name: auto_script
methods.description: Sets current directory to script's directory, retrieves input/output dependencies, then resets to root.

methods.name: md5
methods.description: Calculates MD5 hash of a file.

methods.name: get_hash_file_name
methods.description: Generates a filename for storing hashes based on generator name.

methods.name: any_hash_dirty
methods.description: Checks if any input/output files have changed since last hash.

methods.name: any_old_hash_missing
methods.description: Checks if any expected hash files are missing or outdated.

methods.name: update_output_hashes
methods.description: Updates hash records for output files.

methods.name: load_hashes
methods.description: Loads stored hashes from the hash directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function managing dependency checks, script execution, and hash updates.
